UPDATE promos SET title = ?, title_de = ?, feature_1 = ?, feature_1_de = ?, feature_2 = ?, feature_2_de = ?, feature_3 = ?, feature_3_de = ?,
                        price = ?, price_de = ?, link = ?, image = COALESCE(?, image), updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = ?
